title: Stabilo Optimize: A Framework for Comprehensive Evaluation and Analysis for the Stabilo Library
description:
⚠️ Archived: this repository is archived and no longer developed. Its successor is Stabilo Benchmark 🎯.

Stabilo-Optimize is a Python benchmarking tool designed specifically to evaluate and tune methods and hyperparameters of the Stabilo ⚖️ library for video and track stabilization tasks. It systematically generates performance evaluations through random perturbations, eliminating the need for ground-truth homographies. This tool significantly simplifies the optimization of stabilization techniques, making it ideal for high-precision tasks in fields such as urban monitoring, traffic analysis, and drone imagery processing.

About the successor: Stabilo Benchmark 🎯 continues this project. Stabilo-Optimize tunes Stabilo under random perturbations of static scenes, the campaign of the associated article. Stabilo Benchmark extends that campaign to complete registration pipelines (feature detector, descriptor, matcher, robust estimator and object masking) on static and real dynamic urban scenes, scored against an audited reference. It is the benchmark of the paper "Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes" (arXiv preprint), whose inputs and results are in a data record on Zenodo.

📌 Important: If you use this code in your work, kindly acknowledge it by citing the following article:

Robert Fonod, Haechan Cho, Hwasoo Yeo, Nikolas Geroliminis (2025). Advanced computer vision for extracting georeferenced vehicle trajectories from drone imagery, Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies, vol. 178, 105205. DOI: 10.1016/j.trc.2025.105205

Why Stabilo-Optimize

  • Ground Truth-Free Benchmarking: Randomly generates photometric and homographic perturbations (brightness variations, Gaussian blur, saturation adjustments, fog effects, rotations, translations, scales, and perspective shifts).
  • Hierarchical Benchmarking Strategy: Encourages users to systematically vary hyperparameters hierarchically for efficient parameter optimization.
  • Flexible JSON Configuration: Customize extensive parameter settings using nested dictionaries.
  • Result Visualization: Generates comprehensive performance plots and benchmarking process visualizations.

Benchmarking Metrics

Benchmarks use metrics like Homography Estimation Accuracy (HEA) and Mean Intersection over Union (MIoU). MIoU specifically evaluates the accuracy of object-level registration and requires bounding box masks for calculation. Detailed metric definitions and analysis are provided in the manuscript.

🔗 Related Projects
  • Stabilo ⚖️: the video and trajectory stabilization library that Stabilo-Optimize benchmarks and tunes.
  • Stabilo Benchmark 🎯: the successor of Stabilo-Optimize. Extends its static campaign to complete registration pipelines on static and dynamic urban scenes, and is the benchmark of the consensus capture paper, with its data record.
  • Geo-trax 🚀: end-to-end framework for extracting georeferenced vehicle trajectories from drone imagery. Uses Stabilo, tuned via Stabilo-Optimize, as its core stabilization engine.
  • HBB2OBB 🔄: converts horizontal bounding boxes to oriented bounding boxes using SAM segmentation models. Can be used alongside the Stabilo ecosystem when object orientation is needed for downstream analysis.
